subject.title: Feature proposal: codexbar guard — a quota-aware exit code to gate automation

question: Should CodexBar adopt a first-class quota-gating command, and if so should the linked PR's `--need`, `--window`, `--fail-open`, and exit-code contract become the supported CLI API?
rationale: The request adds a new automation capability and durable shell-facing API whose failure semantics cannot be selected safely from implementation evidence alone.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow MVP
options.body: Accept a single-provider percentage guard after reconciling exit status 2, documenting fail-open behavior, and reviewing the linked PR's focused implementation.

options.title: Decline the command surface
options.body: Keep CodexBar's CLI informational and close both the proposal and linked implementation without adding automation-gating semantics.

options.title: Request a revised contract
options.body: Keep the proposal open but ask for a smaller or differently named command and flag contract before implementation review continues.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow MVP
recommendation.body: Accept a single-provider percentage guard after reconciling exit status 2, documenting fail-open behavior, and reviewing the linked PR's focused implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner has the strongest CLI feature history and was explicitly asked to decide whether this product direction belongs in CodexBar.
